# Product Requirements Document: Malformed Product

## Product Overview
Malformed identifiers must fail closed.
## Problem Statement
Loose identifiers break stable references.
## Scope Summary
Identifier validation is included.
## Product Capability Map
| Capability ID | Capability | Priority | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| CAP-01 | Identifier validation | P1 | References remain stable. |
